what: The Tao #179 sublevel campaign (Erdős #1038, supremum side). Rational-weight discrete measures on [-1,1] with denominator N are monic degree-N polynomials with roots in [-1,1]; this record holds certified sublevel measures |{|q|<1}| (lower-bound witnesses for the conjectured sup 2*sqrt(2)), certified grid champions, and per-degree branch-and-bound THEOREMS: odd degrees 3, 5, 7 fall strictly below 2.82 < 2*sqrt(2); even degrees 4, 6, 8 have supremum in [2*sqrt(2), 2.82845], the left end attained by (x^2-1)^{N/2}. A degree marked failed was ATTEMPTED and is open, not silently dropped. Every measure is an exact outward enclosure from BigInt Sturm root isolation; every branch-and-bound pruning uses the certified min-product box bound (calibrated: thin boxes reproduce measures to all printed digits).
provenance: Conjecture and framing: T. Tao, teorth/erdosproblems#179 (Dec 2025), on erdosproblems.com #1038. The infimum side was resolved by Darvas-Peng-Tao (2026); this campaign addresses the supremum side only.

cubicChampion.note: interior critical root — the degree-3 supremum is NOT at a lattice point and sits near 2.7542

quinticPeak.note: the family (x^2-1)^2(x-r) peaks at a topological transition of the sublevel set near r = 905/1024, then drops discontinuously
